agent_summary: I unconditionally enabled widened AXI memory bursts for `dma_ld` by changing the default fallback of `_WIDEN` in `microarch_isa.py` from `1` to `TpuParams.widest_burst(T, MAXDIM)`. Previously, `dma_ld` was reading one `T`-sized packed word per cycle from DRAM (taking around 128 cycles for a 16x16x16 GEMM's operands), which severely starved the entire array at the beginning of the program. Widening the burst allows the unit to load multiple words per beat (up to the 512-bit bus limit), drastically cutting the DRAM read latency and letting downstream units start computing much earlier. This change relies entirely on the existing parametric derivation (`TpuParams.widest_burst`), so it correctly scales at all tested array dimensions and parameter sizes (e.g. MAXDIM 8, 12, 16, 32) without relying on test-specific data layout assumptions.

 # design; `TPU_DMA_WIDEN=1` selects the widest beat the 64-byte bus holds, and
 # `TPU_DMA_WORDS` names one directly.
-_WIDEN = TpuParams.widest_burst(T, MAXDIM) if os.environ.get("TPU_DMA_WIDEN") == "1" else 1
+_WIDEN = TpuParams.widest_burst(T, MAXDIM)
 DMA_WORDS = int(os.environ.get("TPU_DMA_WORDS", _WIDEN))
